0.why: MIDIRecorder.cpp:604 sets one voltage, 10V while actively recording and 0V otherwise

comment: CVRange::to7bit and to14bit divide by high rather than by high minus low (CVRange.hpp:14 and 19), so every bipolar range option is wrong: with the -5 to 5 range, which is the pitchbend default, 0V already reads as the maximum and only -5V to 0V has any effect. The unipolar ranges, including all four defaults except pitchbend, are correct. The README calls AFT polyphonic, but the code reads it with getVoltage (MIDIRecorder.cpp:440 and 458), so only channel 0 is used and its value is written to every channel of the track. The Start/Stop parameter (index 0) has no widget: the REC button is a custom SvgButton that sets its own flag, and the parameter is never read (the line that would read it is commented out at MIDIRecorder.cpp:576). The Text Style parameter (index 1) has no widget either; it is set from the Text Color menu that every module in this plugin carries.
